version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the config file.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description:
The current log level of the program.
Valid values are 1-6 or "Verbose", "Debug", "Info", "Warn", "Error", "Fatal"

equivalents.title: Equivalents
equivalents.description: A list of equivalents for transcribing Windows paths.

sid.title: Windows SSID/Unix UID
sid.description: The specified user's Windows SSID or if the OS is Unix their Unix UID.

username.title: Windows/Unix Username
username.description: The specified user's Windows domain/username or if the OS is Unix their Unix username.

admin_config.title: System/Admin Config
admin_config.description: The data for the system or admin config.

root.title: Auxilary Path Information
root.description: An object containing the information about the auxilary path directory.

name.title: Auxilary Path Environment Variable Name
name.description: The name of the environment variable of the auxilary directory.

path.title: Auxilary Path Directory
path.description: The path to the auxilary directory.

aux_list_name.title: Auxilary Path List Name
aux_list_name.description: The name of the auxilary path list environment variable.

programs.title: List of Programs in Auxilary Path List
programs.description: Paths to directories to split into the sublist of paths for Windows compatibility.

force_in_path.title: Force These Paths in System/User Path
force_in_path.description: Paths to directories to specifically force to keep in the system/user path variable.

custom_environment_variables.title: Custom Environment Variables
custom_environment_variables.description: A list of custom environment variables.

custom_environment_variable.title: Custom Environment Variable
custom_environment_variable.description:
A single custom environment variable.
If the type of the key/value is an array these will be joined via the system's path variable separator.
